arguments.value: Yaskawa Electric Corporation (YEC) and Argo Medical Technologies Ltd. (ARGO) entered into a strategic alliance to collaborate on healthcare robotics. The agreement covers YEC helping market, distribute, and commercialize ARGO’s products under a separate distribution agreement, while ARGO may market future YEC healthcare products within its sales network. YEC also agreed to invest by purchasing ARGO Series D-1 Convertible Preferred Shares under a separate share purchase agreement. The parties formed a joint steering committee to coordinate sales, research and development, manufacturing, and product improvements, including possible licensed manufacturing and future joint development. The agreement lasts 10 years from the effective date, with possible renewal, and may be terminated earlier for material breach or by mutual written consent. It does not create a partnership or joint venture, preserves each party’s intellectual property rights unless separately licensed, requires a new NDA for confidential information, and bars each side from soliciting the other’s personnel for 12 months after the collaboration ends. The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Israel, and disputes must be brought exclusively in the courts of Tel Aviv, Israel.
